title: 意群与停顿
goal: 把一句话切分成意群；判断停顿的位置是否合适。
exam: TOEFL iBT（2026 年 1 月起的新版）· 口语

points.label: 判断停顿的位置是否合适

body.p: 意群是意思和语法上联系紧密的一组词。本课用斜线 / 标出意群的边界。边界处可以停顿，但不是每处都要停。短句可以连贯说完，长主语和补充说明后面更常需要停顿。

body.box: The new members of the orchestra / will attend an extra rehearsal / before the public concert.

body.p: 切分时先保住短语内部的关系，再定边界。the public concert 的冠词、修饰语和名词属于同一短语。不能为了让各段词数相近而在 the 后停顿。

cards.title: 意群边界
rows: 主语与谓语之间
长主语后可以停顿，短主语后不停。
The students assigned to the morning shift / will prepare the display.
介词短语前
较长的时间、地点短语可以单独成群，介词归在短语里。
The labels will remain visible / under the protective glass.
状语从句前
主句和原因、时间、条件从句之间可以分开，连接词归从句。
The trial will continue / unless the equipment becomes unstable.
并列成分前
并列的动词或分句之间可以分开，and 归后一个意群。
The technician will inspect the casing / and replace the damaged seal.
插入语两侧
补充说明单独成群，删去后主句仍然完整。
The revised schedule, / according to the coordinator, / will arrive tomorrow.
定语从句前
较长的定语从句前可以停顿。从句修饰的仍是前面的名词。
The team thanked the volunteer / who had translated the handwritten notes.

cards.title: 意群内部
rows: 冠词与名词
a、the 和后面的名词连着说，不留在前一个意群末尾。
A detailed map of the district / hangs beside the entrance.
介词与宾语
in、of 等介词和后面的宾语连着说，介词后不停。
The colored markers are kept / in a separate wooden drawer.
助动词与主要动词
has 和后面的过去分词之间不停。
The team responsible for the survey / has completed the initial count.
形容词与名词
修饰同一名词的几个词和名词连着说。
The organizers requested several additional folding tables / for the outdoor session.
动词与短宾语
短的动词加宾语连着说，不逐词分开。
Please keep the receipt / until the replacement arrives.
插入语与主句
插入语说完后回到主句，插入语不并入谓语。
The spare battery, / despite its larger size, / fits inside the case.

body.box:
The dancers from the evening class, despite the narrow stage, completed the final sequence without a break.
The dancers from the evening class / despite the narrow stage / completed the final sequence / without a break.

body.p: The dancers from the evening class 是完整的主语。despite the narrow stage 是插入的补充说明，两侧都可以停顿。completed the final sequence 是动词加宾语，连着说。

body.box: Proposed boundary: The dancers from / the evening class …

body.p: 这里 from 和宾语 the evening class 被分开了。边界移到 class 后，主语才完整。边界的位置看结构，不看词数是否相等。

lines.text: The team responsible for lighting will inspect the cables before rehearsal.

items.stem: Which phrase is the complete subject?
items.why: The team responsible for lighting 整体是主语，谓语从 will inspect 开始。第四项把 responsible for lighting 划进了谓语。

lines.text: The beekeeper checked the hive and recorded the weight of the frame.

items.stem: Where can the two coordinated actions be separated?
items.why: checked the hive 和 recorded the weight of the frame 是两个并列动作，边界在 and recorded 前。

lines.text: The river survey was delayed because the measuring pole was damaged.

items.stem: Which phrase begins the reason clause?
items.why: because the measuring pole was damaged 是原因从句，从句从 because 开始。第四项漏了 because。

lines.text: The course assistant, according to the notice, will collect the folders.

items.stem: Which words form the inserted comment?
items.why: according to the notice 是补充信息。删去后，The course assistant will collect the folders 仍然完整。

groups.text: The repair kit is stored under / the workbench.

items.stem: Which boundary breaks a prepositional phrase?
items.why: under the workbench 中，under 不能与宾语分开。

groups.text: Several bright / lanterns marked the route.

items.stem: Which boundary separates a modifier from its noun?
items.why: bright 修饰 lanterns，bright 后的停顿拆开了名词短语。

groups.text: The evening guards have / checked every window.

items.stem: Which boundary interrupts the verb phrase?
items.why: have checked 是现在完成时的谓语。have 后停顿，拆开了助动词和主要动词。

groups.text: The new guide, according to the editor / will include larger maps.

items.stem: Where is the missing opening boundary for the inserted comment?
items.why: according to the editor 是插入语，前后各要一个边界。editor 后已有边界，缺的是 according 前那个。

lines.text: The divers waiting beside the boat will check their oxygen tanks.

items.stem: Which phrase belongs together as the complete subject?
options: The divers waiting beside the boat
The divers waiting beside the boat will
items.why: The divers waiting beside the boat 是带修饰语的主语，谓语从 will check 开始。第三项把 will 也算进了主语。

lines.text: The textile samples will remain sealed until the humidity is stable.

items.stem: Which words begin the time clause?
items.why: until the humidity is stable 是时间从句，从句从 until 开始。

lines.text: The librarian counted the donated journals and placed them in labeled boxes.

items.stem: Which division separates the two coordinated actions?
items.why: counted the donated journals 和 placed them in labeled boxes 是两个并列动作，边界在 and placed 前。

lines.text: The sculpture base, despite its uneven surface, supports the clay model.

items.stem: Which sequence is an inserted comment rather than the main subject or predicate?
options: The base supports the clay model
items.why: despite its uneven surface 是插入说明。删去后，The sculpture base supports the clay model 仍是完整的句子。

groups.text: The wildlife camera recorded movement near / the feeding platform.

items.stem: Which change preserves the location phrase as one unit?
options: Move the slash to before near.
Move the slash to after the.
Move the slash to after feeding.
Keep the slash immediately after near.
items.why: near the feeding platform 是介词短语。边界移到 near 前，这个短语才完整。

groups.text: The ceramics judge has / selected the final entries.

options: The subject should include the final entries.
The adjective final should be separated from entries.
The auxiliary has has been split from selected.
The verb selected should be separated from its short object.
items.why: has selected 是完整的谓语，斜线拆开了助动词和分词。

groups.text: The tunnel inspectors, after a brief discussion / approved the safety plan.

items.stem: Where should an opening boundary be added to isolate the comment?
items.why: after a brief discussion 是插入说明，前后各要一个边界。discussion 后已有边界，缺的是 inspectors 后那个。

groups.text: The debate coach requested a / detailed written summary.

items.stem: Which proposal keeps the noun phrase intact?
options: Keep a detailed written summary together.
Keep requested a together as the final unit.
items.why: a detailed written summary 是完整的名词短语，a、detailed、written 都和 summary 连着说。
